story.fullStory:
Bob Marley's "Redemption Song" — original release 1980. "Redemption Song" is a song by Jamaican singer Bob Marley.

It is the final track on Bob Marley and the Wailers' twelfth album, Uprising, produced by Chris Blackwell and released by Island Records.

The song is considered one of Marley's greatest works.
